title: Tigriopus californicus proteome heterodimers (AFDB complexes)
ids: UniProt accession (<accession>_<range> when one accession has several fragments in this screen)

source.citation: Han Y, et al. (2026). AlphaFold Database expands to proteome-scale quaternary structures. bioRxiv. Models: AlphaFold Database complexes release (heterodimers), EMBL-EBI / Google DeepMind / NVIDIA and collaborators, ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/alphafold/collaborations/nvda/heterodimers, CC BY 4.0. Scores computed with lis.py (AFM-LIS).
source.method: AlphaFold-Multimer v3, one model per pair (model_1_multimer_v3); rescored with lis.py. iLIS cutoffs were calibrated on best-of-5 models, so at the same cutoff this screen is less sensitive; a low iLIS here means "not seen by model_1".
